description: This file defines a PyTorch extension module that interfaces with Metal Performance Shaders (MPS) on Apple hardware. It includes Metal shader code for GPU operations, functions for CPU and MPS tensor addition, and bindings via pybind11 to expose these functions as a Python module.

methods.name: get_cpu_add_output
methods.description: Performs element-wise addition of two CPU tensors.

methods.name: get_mps_add_output
methods.description: Performs element-wise addition of two MPS tensors using Metal kernels.

methods.name: mps_add_one_new_encoder
methods.description: Increments each element of an MPS tensor by 1 using a Metal compute kernel.
